headline: EnSIMem links structured memory indexes to source-grounded conversational evidence
summary: EnSIMem stores dialogue-grounded entity/property indexes as addresses into theme-coherent episodes, then decomposes a query into evidence requirements and retrieves the original source turns needed to answer it. The authors report LoCoMo overall accuracy of 90.6% under GPT-4o-mini and 90.0% under Qwen3-32B, and LongMemEval accuracy of 92.8% under both evaluators. A fixed LoCoMo ablation reports 96.59% for structured entity/type/property retrieval versus 86.36% for dense retrieval. These are paper-reported, LLM-evaluated results. The reported online latency is 14.4 seconds versus 5.70 seconds for MEMORA(P); some comparator rows are transcribed rather than rerun.
